verdict.rationale: Justworks has its own payroll reporting feature: the docs point admins to 'Analytics > Custom Payroll Report' to check employee payroll data, which roughly corresponds to a payroll register. The evidence never describes the report's contents, a gross-to-net breakdown, or any export format. The Xero mapping and sync is an accounting integration, not a report export for analysis, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented payroll register contents, gross-to-net report, export capability (CSV/XLSX), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can generate payroll registers and gross-to-net reports and export them for analysis
